How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for TIFR Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TIFR Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the TIFR Project Engineer recruitment is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E. / B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering or Electronics & (Tele)Communications Engineering with at least 60% aggregate marks.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in designing and debugging high-speed analog, digital, and VLSI circuits is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 29 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the TIFR Project Engineer job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is correctly mentioned.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Engineer post.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the TIFR located?
faq.answer: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
